The image shows a banana leaf with numerous elongated dark brown/black necrotic spots and streaks, many surrounded by yellow chlorotic halos. The lesions are densely distributed across the leaf blade with pronounced yellowing along the leaf margin. This pattern of elongated streaks/spots with yellow halos is the classic signature of Sigatoka disease.
